instruction: Candid documentary wide shot of an indoor studio with a red carpet and wooden floor. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right facing left, touching the right shoulder of the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) with her right hand. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the room.
elements: R2 touches R1's right shoulder with her right hand
R1 receives the shoulder touch from R2
R2 faces R1 while making the shoulder contact
R1 and R2 are in an indoor studio
the studio has a red carpet and wooden floor

questions.q: Is R2 touching R1's shoulder with her right hand, rather than R1 touching R2's shoulder?
questions.element: R2 is the active shoulder toucher and R1 is the recipient

questions.element: R1 receives the shoulder contact from R2
